results.reasoning: (A) 'involve the ___ of physiological resources' → 회복 맥락이므로 restoration. (B) 'attention, ___, mental energy' → motivation. (C) 'whether ___ recovery is obtained' → adequate.
(A) 'process as well as an ___' → outcome. (B) 'the ___ of physical fatigue' → absence (회복되면 피로 없음). (C) 'recovery processes ___ recovery outcomes' → precede (과정이 결과에 선행).
(A) 'those ___ and experiences' → activities. (B) 'consequently, ___ whether adequate recovery' → determine. (C) 'the ___ effective way' → most.
② exhaustion(소진)은 원문 restoration(회복)과 정반대. 나머지 ①process, ③motivation, ④adequate는 원문 그대로.
③ succeed(뒤따르다)는 원문 precede(선행하다)와 정반대. 나머지는 원문 그대로.
④ exercise(운동)는 원문 inactivity(비활동)와 정반대. 나머지 ①outcome, ②absence, ③change는 원문 그대로.
'involve the ___ of physiological resources such as muscle strength' → 자원의 회복 = restoration. 문맥상 회복 결과에 대한 내용.
'recovery processes ___ recovery outcomes' → 과정이 결과보다 먼저 온다 = precede.
'determine whether ___ recovery is obtained' → 충분한/적절한 회복 = adequate.
restoration(복원/회복) ≈ recovery(회복). destruction, consumption, distribution은 모두 다른 의미.
adequate(적절한/충분한) ≈ sufficient(충분한). excessive, minimal, partial은 모두 다른 의미.
determine(결정하다) ≈ decide(결정하다). undermine, postpone, prevent는 모두 다른 의미.
absence(부재) ↔ presence(존재). shortage, decline, weakness는 반의어가 아님.
precede(선행하다) ↔ follow(뒤따르다). anticipate, accompany, predict는 반의어가 아님.
(A) physiological and psychological state → 상태. (B) state of the union address → 국가(연방/국정). (A)상태-(B)국가 = ③.
'bringing something back to its original condition' = 원래 상태로 되돌림 = restoration(복원). motivation, fatigue, absence는 해당 안 됨.
'___ (physiology) resources' → 명사 resources를 수식하는 형용사 필요 → physiological.
'physiological and ___ (psychology) state' → physiological과 병렬 형용사 → psychological.
'states act as ___ for upcoming activities' → 스트레스 완충 자원 역할 = a resource that functions as a stress-buffer.
'___ is generally considered the most effective way to restore physiological resources' → physical inactivity. 본문 마지막 문장의 핵심.
